entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker ghost-assassin who can phase through blows, hunting an extraplanar monster across Kaldheim's realms.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A red-skinned, horned devil planeswalker who disguises himself as the god Valki to stir the Hagi trolls to war and wakes Torga trolls to kill Kaya.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
aliases: Prince of the elves of Skemfar
entities.description: A vain, muscular elf prince of Skemfar who can turn creatures to stone and open doorways between realms, and who wears a Zendikari hedron charm, revealing he is a planeswalker.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: The god who gave Kaya Cosima's longship and warned of a Doomskar.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: The Omenseeker clan leader who told Kaya about Omenpaths.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description: Tyvar's brother, the elf ruler at court, who is preparing the elves for war after Tibalt's visit.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: The goddess whose longship carries Kaya.

entities.name: Hagi trolls
entities.description: A crowd of green, tusked trolls of the Gnottvold addressed by Tibalt, led by four large armored brutes.

entities.name: Torga trolls
entities.description: Twenty-foot geological trolls sleeping beneath hills who wake enraged; Tyvar turns them to stone.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: The explorer clan Kaya traveled with.

entities.name: Elves of Skemfar
entities.description: The elves preparing for war against the gods after Tibalt's visit to court.

entities.name: Cosima's longship
entities.description: A god's ship that carried Kaya through the Cosmos with no oars or rudder.

entities.name: Tibalt's glass sword
entities.description: A glass sword with a shifting spectrum of colors that opens a portal to Immersturm.

entities.name: Zendikari hedron charm
entities.description: A small etched stone from Zendikar among Tyvar's charms.

entities.name: Gnottvold
entities.description: The troll realm with ancient forests and warrens.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm of demons seen through Tibalt's portal.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The elf realm whose sorcerers Tyvar boasts of.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: A frozen realm of wraiths and undead that once collided with Bretagard.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The realm Kaya came from.

entities.name: Beskir Stronghold
entities.description: A stronghold the undead legion once reached.

entities.name: Aldergard
entities.description: The forest where Kaya saw the metal veins.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Tyvar's stone came from.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The Viking plane of nine realms.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A celestial collision of realms, which Alrund said is coming.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Temporary links between realms.

events.summary: Kaya rides Cosima's longship through the Cosmos and learns from Inga about Omenpaths and Doomskars.
events.quote: It was the Doomskars people feared, though—celestial collisions that seemed invariably to lead to calamity.

events.summary: The longship lands Kaya on a muddy bank in an ancient forest in the Gnottvold, then departs.
events.quote: the boat lurched back into the waves as if it had been pushed

events.summary: Kaya finds a crowd of trolls and a hooded man on a stone block calling himself Valki, the God of Lies.
events.quote: All know me as Valki, and my first gift to you, the gift of languages, is free.

events.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, urges the troll clans to attack first against invaders from other worlds.
events.quote: the clans of the Gnottvold must attack first!

events.summary: Kaya blows away Valki's illusion, revealing the devil planeswalker Tibalt.
events.quote: in place of the God of Lies stood a red-skinned man with two prominent horns

events.summary: Tibalt orders his trolls to kill Kaya; she incapacitates two with phasing, and the others flee.
events.quote: The second jabbed at her with a rusty, ancient-looking sword.

events.summary: Kaya chases Tibalt and corners him; he says chaos is its own reward and denies knowledge of the monster.
events.quote: Chaos is its own reward, and nothing puts a smile on my face like a bit of mayhem.

events.summary: Tibalt whistles and wakes six Torga trolls from beneath the hills.
events.quote: One after another, they pulled free of the earth, showering the clearing with clumps of black dirt.

events.summary: Tibalt opens a portal to a fiery realm with a glass sword and leaves Kaya with the trolls.
events.quote: With that, he stepped through the portal.

events.summary: Kaya fights the Torga trolls, her dagger breaking and another lodging in a troll's spine.
events.quote: she watched the dagger she'd had since Tolvada break in two

events.summary: Tyvar Kell arrives and turns all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch.
events.quote: He dodged another blow, turned another troll to stone, and another.

events.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
events.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

events.summary: Kaya identifies the portal's destination as Immersturm, realm of demons, and links the plan to the Doomskar.
Tyvar opens a doorway into the Cosmos, and Kaya spots his Zendikari charm and realizes he is a planeswalker.

relations.note: He orders her killed and leaves her with trolls.
relations.quote: so if you'll excuse me—kill her!

relations.note: They team up after he saves her.

relations.quote: Not long ago he came to see my brother in court.
the skin of his arm and hand appeared to be growing polished and hard

relations.note: Tyvar suspected Tibalt for some time and is following him.
relations.quote: I'd been suspicious of him for some time, though.
